claims: Reassess and manage severe metabolic acidosis with elevated anion gap and rising lactate; consider repeat blood gas and lactate, and continue bicarbonate therapy as ordered.
Monitor and manage hyperglycemia (glucose >300 mg/dL) with insulin therapy and frequent glucose checks.
Reassess and manage hypokalemia (potassium 3.0-3.7 mEq/L) with potassium replacement and monitoring.
Reassess and manage hypocalcemia (ionized calcium 1.09-1.15 mmol/L, total calcium 6.4-6.8 mg/dL) with calcium replacement and monitoring.

Monitor and manage hypotension (arterial BP as low as 80/57 mmHg) with ongoing vasopressor support and fluid resuscitation as ordered.

Monitor liver function tests (AST 96-139, ALT 66-70, alkaline phosphatase 231-241) and coagulation (PT/INR, PTT).
Perform a thorough medication reconciliation and review of administered medications (including thiamine, folic acid, multivitamins) to ensure appropriate continuation.
